summary: Iter86 backend-only testing complete. 14/14 pytest tests pass covering: (1) empty-route filter in auto-backfill, (2) empty-route filter in manual backfill endpoint, (3-5) additive quota scenarios A/B/C (total never exceeds max_daily_audits across multiple run_daily_selection invocations), (6) phase + journey_id preservation of already-selected drivers, (7) idempotency without new plans, (8) max_daily=0 edge, (9) cap-saturated late driver → unselected, (10) iter85 auto-backfill regression, (11) /api/health + scheduler + /api/admin/routes-report regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Worker correctly reads already_selected BEFORE algorithm (line 163-169) and computes remaining_quota = max(0, max_daily - len(already_selected)) — prevents over-selection on backfill re-runs.
candidate_drivers excludes already-selected set, passed with max_daily=remaining_quota to _select_drivers — algorithmic invariant preserved.
Preservation branch (line 217-222): when driver already in already_selected, only plan.processed=True is updated, audit_log NOT upserted — phase + journey_id intact.

Both auto-backfill (services/selection_backfill.py L129-134) and manual backfill (routes/selection_routes.py L306-313) skip routes with empty route_stops consistently; manual endpoint counts them as skipped_no_driver.
unselected cleanup (delete_many L173-175) runs before algorithm so newly-arrived drivers in 2nd run can be re-evaluated against remaining quota.
Summary totals use selected_set = already_selected | new_selected (L197), so summary.selected reflects the cumulative count correctly.
Non-blocking observation: when remaining_quota=0 and there are new candidate drivers, loop still writes unselected rows — good. Ensures visibility of drivers that could not be audited due to cap.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter86 (cupo aditivo + filtro rutas vacías) validated end-to-end. 14 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter86_additive_quota.py. Key invariants: (a) selected_count per date never exceeds max_daily_audits across N backfill runs, (b) drivers already selected keep original phase and journey_id, (c) routes with zero route_stops are skipped in both backfill paths. Live endpoints /api/health, /api/admin/routes-report verified. Scheduler logs show clean startup without import errors. No changes to webhook path (_handle_plan_created) required.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a feature validation, not a bug fix iteration. The fix in routal_selection_worker.py L156-193 correctly implements the additive quota by computing remaining_quota from existing audit_log entries before calling _select_drivers with only new candidates.
